clue.text: End period at school in America

parts.note: a school year is divided into terms
US is the abbreviation for the United States, i.e. America

explanation.surface: A school term in the United States draws to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the final stop of a line, the place where a route ends.

clue.text: Not at first, imagine unravelling riddle

indicators.note: unravelling suggests a tangle being undone and the letters falling into a new order
the word imagine is to be used without its opening letter

explanation.surface: An instruction not to dream up a puzzle too soon, as the riddle comes apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not at first' drops the I of IMAGINE, leaving MAGINE; 'unravelling' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma is a puzzling statement or mystery, which is just what a riddle is.

clue.text: Poser is one to be copied

definitions.meaning: a ... poses for an artist or photographer

explanation.surface: Someone who strikes poses is an example others imitate.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a sitter for an artist and an exemplar or template for imitation.

clue.text: Exclusion zone where spiders rule?

definitions.meaning: airspace from which aircraft are banned
a place spiders control would have no flies left in it

explanation.surface: A banned area, jokingly pictured as a kingdom of spiders.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes 'fly' as the insect: spiders would leave none about.
explanation.definitionFit: Military powers declare such airspace closed, excluding aircraft from it entirely.

clue.text: Wise ape isn't going berserk

indicators.note: something going berserk runs wild, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A clever ape is not losing control.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapient is a formal adjective for having great wisdom or discernment.

clue.text: Back, not front, in black coat

indicators.note: the shortened word goes inside the colour

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black

indicators.note: the word Back is to lose its opening letter

explanation.surface: A garment described: its back, not its front, is in black.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not front' drops B from BACK, leaving ACK, which goes 'in' JET.
explanation.definitionFit: A jacket is a short coat worn over other clothing.

clue.text: Panellist on trial

parts.note: the panel here is a jury sitting in a court case, not a quiz show

explanation.surface: A quiz-show panellist seems to be in the dock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Panellist' suggests television; the panel is the jury and 'on trial' means serving at one.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a jury sits on the jury panel during a court case.

clue.text: Music of the highest rank?

definitions.meaning: the genre of serious Western concert music
... also means of the first class, of acknowledged excellence

explanation.surface: A boast about music being top class.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a genre and also describes work of lasting, first-class standing.

clue.text: At all times to a greater extent until the end of time

parts.note: ever means always
more means to a greater degree

explanation.surface: A string of phrases about eternity and increase.
explanation.definitionFit: Evermore is a poetic word meaning forever, always into the future.

clue.text: Somewhat unkind, offensively somewhat

indicators.note: only some of what is written is used, so the answer sits within these words

explanation.surface: A remark judged a little unkind and rather offensive.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'somewhat' does a second job: only part of 'unkind, offensively' is taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind of is an informal phrase meaning rather or to some degree.

clue.text: Equality accepted and shared

parts.note: par means equal standing, as in 'on a par'
taken means accepted, as an offer

explanation.surface: Fairness was agreed and everyone had a portion.
explanation.definitionFit: To partake of something is to take a share in it, so partaken is the past participle meaning shared.

clue.text: One has a job to be one

definitions.text: One has a job to be one

parts.words: One has a job to be one
parts.note: a riddle: holding a job is all it takes to qualify as this kind of person

explanation.surface: A circular statement about what makes a worker a worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Anyone engaged by an employer to do paid work is by definition on the staff.

clue.text: Take for granted quietly missing 'Carry On'

indicators.note: missing tells us the quiet letter is absent from the longer word

parts.note: to presume is to assume without proof
p (piano) is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone assumes, without a word, that a Carry On film is not there.
explanation.walkthrough: Carry On films are a long-running series of British comedy films, a red herring here.
explanation.definitionFit: To resume is to continue after a pause, the same as carry on.

clue.text: Be aware of the facts as to how many runs have been made?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for understanding the real situation

definitions.text: as to how many runs have been made?
definitions.meaning: literally, knowing the score of a cricket or baseball match in runs

explanation.surface: A spectator who keeps up with the runs on the scoreboard.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means grasping how matters truly stand, borrowed from following a match tally.

clue.text: Limit of pedestrianism

parts.note: the edge of the pavement, beyond which walkers step into the road

explanation.surface: It sounds like a complaint about the outer bound of dullness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pedestrianism' suggests dullness; read it as walking on the pavement.
explanation.definitionFit: The stones lining the pavement edge mark where the walkway stops and the road begins.

clue.text: He in Devon involved Dutch city

indicators.note: involved means tangled or intricate, so these letters are twisted into another order

explanation.surface: A man in Devon, an English county, had dealings with a Dutch city.
explanation.definitionFit: Eindhoven is a large city in the south of the Netherlands, home of PSV and Philips.

clue.text: Advice from youngster in uniform about African party

indicators.note: the uniformed youngster is placed around the party

parts.note: a Guide is a uniformed member of the Girl Guides
the ANC is the African National Congress of South Africa

explanation.surface: A uniformed girl gives counsel about an African political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Guidance is direction or counsel given to help someone decide.

clue.text: Fourth last antepenultimate contest

parts.note: a quarter is one fourth
final means last

explanation.surface: A puzzling list of ordinals: fourth, last, third from last.
explanation.walkthrough: Antepenultimate means third from last: the quarter-finals come before the semi-finals and the final.
explanation.definitionFit: In a knockout tournament this round is the third-to-last stage of competition.

clue.text: Unattached monks' liberty

parts.note: free means not tied or committed
Dom is the title given to Benedictine and some other monks

explanation.surface: Monks who belong to no order enjoy their liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: Freedom and liberty are synonyms for the state of being free from constraint.

clue.text: Anselm struggles to find race venue

indicators.note: struggles suggests writhing and twisting, so these letters are thrown into another order

explanation.surface: A man named Anselm has trouble locating where a race is held.
explanation.definitionFit: Le Mans in France hosts the famous 24-hour motor race.

clue.text: Team backed working for inventor

indicators.note: backed means the word for team is turned to run backwards

parts.note: a side is a sports team
on means operating, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A team supported the efforts of an inventor at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Edison was the American who patented the phonograph and a practical light bulb.

clue.text: Orange part of the body?

explanation.surface: A query whether some orange thing is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a sweet orange variety and the small hollow in the abdomen.

clue.text: Encouraged old Rod, the eccentric

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so these letters are set awry

explanation.surface: An elderly odd fellow named Rod spurred others on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' looks like a description of Rod but rearranges RODTHE into HORTED.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhort is to urge strongly, so exhorted means encouraged or urged on.

clue.text: Musical work penned by Byron downloaded

indicators.note: penned by means enclosed within, so the answer sits inside these words

explanation.surface: A piece of music written by the poet Byron, obtained online.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo is a musical form with a recurring main theme, often a closing movement.

clue.text: Implicated in car stopping short with reporter

indicators.note: stopping short means the car name is cut before its final letter

parts.note: Volvo is a Swedish make of car
ed is short for editor, here standing for a newspaper journalist

explanation.surface: Someone was drawn into a car halting abruptly alongside a journalist.
explanation.definitionFit: To be involved in something is to be implicated in it, caught up as a participant.

clue.text: Val literally a wrecker!

wordplay.reading: V, 'and', then AL: VAL split open

parts.note: literally asks for the name's letters as written, with a conjunction set between the first and the rest

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a woman called Val is a destroyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'literally' means take the letters of Val as written: V, then AL, joined by 'and'.
explanation.definitionFit: A vandal deliberately damages or destroys property, a wrecker of things.

clue.text: Show about meat

parts.note: re means regarding or concerning
veal is the meat of a calf

explanation.surface: A display concerning meat, like a butcher's exhibition.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal something is to show or disclose it.

clue.text: My French bird, it has four legs!

parts.note: mon is French for my
a goose is a bird

explanation.surface: A French speaker says their bird has four legs, absurdly.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation mark flags the joke: a bird with four legs is no bird at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A mongoose is a small four-footed carnivorous mammal, quite unlike any bird.
